data.narrative:
Sygaldry Technologies is a Series A AI & Software company seeking valuation after raising $139M to date. The comparable universe comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Palantir), spanning frontier AI infrastructure and applied AI across similar and adjacent stages. Key private peers include Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Together AI ($8.3B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression anchors to total capital raised ($139M) and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding $278M. Peer-median triangulation across the 4-company comparable set (range: $3.2B–$25.0B) produces a median valuation of $7.0B, reflecting the elevated growth multiples commanded by frontier AI infrastructure firms at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $236M to $8.0B, with a median of $3.6B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Sygaldry's specific technical differentiation, unit economics, and market position relative to highly valued peers like Reflection AI. Stage-progression yields a more conservative result anchored to capital deployed, while peer-median is anchored to market comparables but may overweight outliers. Without clarity on revenue, growth rate, or competitive moats, the median estimate of $3.6B should be treated as a reference point rather than a point estimate.
